title: Classes
meta_description: Barista classes above the shop — espresso, milk and home brewing.
sections:
We run classes upstairs on Tuesday and Thursday evenings, six people at a time, on the same machines we use downstairs. You will make a lot of coffee and throw quite a bit of it away, which is how anyone learns this.

No experience needed for the first two. Bring your own beans to the home brewing one if you like — half the point is working out what your kit is doing wrong.

Book a place

Do I need my own machine?
No. There is a machine each in the room upstairs. The home brewing class needs no equipment at all, though you are welcome to bring yours.
Can I buy it for someone else?
Yes, and most people do. Tell us at the counter and we will write a card — they can pick whichever evening suits them.
What if I have to miss it?
Let us know a day ahead and we will move you to another evening. Later than that and we have already bought the milk.

Six places an evening

Tuesdays and Thursdays, 6:30 till 8:30, upstairs. They go quickly in the run-up to Christmas.
